name: Sergey Brin
person: Sergey Brin, co-founder of Google (1998, with Larry Page) and Alphabet, stepped back from day-to-day executive roles in Dec 2019, re-engaged hands-on with Gemini/AI around 2023-2024. NOT any other Sergey Brin. IMPORTANT: he is genuinely reclusive, gives very few interviews, has no blog/essay habit like most of this roster. Do NOT pad the corpus with weak secondary sources or inflate thin material to look like more than it is. If the honest count of primary/substantial sources is modest, report that honestly rather than force it toward this project's usual scale.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (the 2004 IPO "Owner's Manual" founders' letter, the All-In Miami 2024 interview transcript, the Google I/O 2025 fireside with Demis Hassabis, the Stanford centennial talk Dec 2025, a leaked internal Gemini memo Mar 2025).
1. Search specifically for the full text or transcript of the leaked internal memo to Gemini staff (Mar 2025), the dossier references it but may not quote it directly; find the actual leaked text if it's been published anywhere.
2. Look for any other founders' letters he co-authored with Larry Page beyond the 2004 IPO letter (annual founders' letters existed for several years after 2004), check abc.xyz/investor/founders-letters/ for the full archive.
3. Any additional recorded talk, fireside chat, or internal all-hands appearance (Google I/O, TED, any conference) where he speaks at length in his own voice, be honest if very little exists beyond what's cited; do not stretch weak secondary write-ups into "primary content."
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item. If you find fewer than 10 genuinely new items, that is an accurate result, report it as such rather than padding with low-value sources.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the ones already known (All-In Miami 2024, EducationNext interview, Google I/O 2025, Stanford Dec 2025 talk).
1. Any 2024-2026 interview/podcast appearance beyond the ones cited, he gives very few, so be thorough but honest if the count is genuinely small.
2. Any interview specifically about his Soviet emigre background and how it shapes his views on censorship/authoritarianism, the dossier has secondary coverage (Quartz, France24) but may lack a direct Brin interview quote on this.
3. Any interview about his Parkinson's-research philanthropy or personal science interests (the dossier flags this as undocumented), find primary material if it exists, or confirm honestly that it doesn't.
Return exact URLs, priority-marked. A short list (4-8 items) is an acceptable, honest result for this reclusive a figure.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (Street View Wi-Fi data-collection scandal, the "threatening AI" comments critique, EPIC's Street View investigations).
1. Critiques of his post-2023 return to hands-on AI work, any named Google/DeepMind employee or industry critic who's pushed back on the 60-hour-week comments or his re-involvement style.
2. Any critique of his and Page's continued super-voting-share control despite stepping back from executive roles, governance critics, shareholder advocates.
3. Critiques of Google's AI strategy under his renewed influence (Gemini rollout stumbles, the image-generation controversy he already admitted to), named critics beyond what's cited.
Return exact URLs, type=critique, 4-8 items, be honest if adversarial material specifically targeting Brin (vs. Google generally) is thin.
